correctness.rationale: Feasibility is exactly functionality plus upper quotas, and all unused positions accept every remaining color. Three minimal nonclosed families follow; each necessary premise is unavoidable for any Horn basis, and jointly they fire to full closure in one parallel pass. Closed-set enumeration counts feasible partial words minus unique missing-color cases. Möbius formulas follow from the explicit signed closure-inversion identity, with cancellation proved for top intervals. Exhaustive independent-model checker supports boundary cases without replacing the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a full heterogeneous-parameter determination of logical consequence structure and incidence-algebra data for the natural fixed-content multiset-word context. The new Möbius value depends sharply on the number of unfinished colors and a signed truncated-multinomial sum. It also displays an unusual coincidence of globally minimum and single-pass bases and explicitly interpolates beyond the known all-ones permutation case.
